program.title: Corrected positive idempotency verification
program.summary: Verify exact-revision idempotency implementation and its public documentation.
program.description: Applicants must provide exact GitHub revision evidence for a deterministic charge handler that replays a matching idempotency key without creating a second charge, plus documentation describing that behavior.

criteria.requirement: The submitted implementation replays a matching idempotency key without creating a second charge and rejects reuse of that key with different payload data.
criteria.evidence_expectations: A bounded source file defining the charge handler and its idempotency behavior.

criteria.requirement: The submitted documentation states that matching idempotency-key requests replay one charge and that conflicting payload reuse is rejected.
criteria.evidence_expectations: A bounded documentation file that describes both replay and conflict behavior.
